statement: Exact kernel-stabilizer descent, induced signed-normalizer and fibre-product kernels, the corrected coefficient-subgroup variant, preservation of the congruence kernel by every effective signed modular automorphism, and the final reconstruction/gluing formalism.
depends_on_doubtful_reading (scan, alter: Scan571(93): S0G versus S0M, determined by the four component maps; scan571 margin tau'_Z versus tau_Z, with an executed S4 counterexample to the former; scan692(4): direct versus semidirect product, fixed by the specified action. Readings are mathematical conclusions from the checked transcriptions, not paleographic certifications.
notes: Executed S4→S3 maps for linked and independent U12 numerical groups, including every image/fibre and full multiplication-map checks; SL2(F3)→A4 gives a genuine nonlifting starred-centralizer element. Universal matrix identities and six finite-ring trace-pair enumerations prove congruence descent. C4/V4 enumeration verifies necessity of extra gluing data. Exact full congruence image/kernel questions and the explicit adelic parameter (B.15.15)-(B.15.16) remain separate from the proved theorem.
